content: An'lɔɔŋ ntɔn mupà an'kab akà aŋàlàmbwà
« Twon lan'kyer balàbal abɛ u mii a baar, ntɔn ba bàlamɛn. Naa tɛy, bɛ bweel làsàwal anki akà Taaràbɛ awà u du.

Twon an'bɛɛr mfuŋ u mii a baar isàkal naa ngye akwen mupà undiir akà ŋàlàmbwà, asànaa bàfàkyer baar a mpem yweel uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà uboo a an'balàbal ntɔn baar basyäŋà. Ndandaa mɛ alakyään, ba bàkyàwal bweel aba itaan.
Wɛɛ akà ngye, mpal apà ngye undiir akà ŋàlàmbwà, wɛy kɔɔ angye likaar làkɔɔn ayöb ndaa làkyerà kɔɔ angye libaal.
Abun, wɛy kab angye làkäl aŋàyee, waa Taaràŋà awà afàman u nku, usafuur la. »
An'lɔɔŋ ntɔn ngyamàkà

« Mpal làyamà bɛ, twon lan'kal asànaa baar a mpem yweel: ba bàfàkwen muyamà umbäär uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà kan'kuun a mbwo ntɔn baar banswà bamɛn. Mɛ alàkyään ndandaa: ba bàkyàwal bweel aba itaan.

Wɛɛ akà ngye, isàkal naa ngye akwen muyamà, bilà u suk angye alà ukwɛl, dübà ibeenà anà sà un'kaŋ a boo, yamà Taaràŋà awà kwo kà ikal a ngyee. Waa Taaràŋà awà afàman u nku, usafuur ya. »
« Mpal làyamà bɛ, twon lan'tɛn itetɛɛn, asànaa baar mpa abà Ayudà: ba bàfàsi naa ba bàsàtɛn mbɔɔn ba bàsàwal nsaak.
Abun, twon làmalab, ntɔn Taaràbɛ akyàyöb naa undiir nà bɛ làbye awà ngyal kusà bɛ mukun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m.
Le bɛ, bɛ làyamà abà:

content.text: wɛy ikɔb angye ikäl kyà in'kyɛɛl,
wɛy ukwen angye bàmɛnà u mɛɛn asànaa abà ba u du.
Ipɛ ŋàbawà isaa byan'kwo akà bi.
Idwääl un'pi a nkul a man'be abi,
asànaa bi ŋakwo sye ifàdwääl bi un'pi a nkul a baar bà ikyer ube.
Twon an'pà mbwo naa bà ilwɛb,
[ Ntɔn imwol, ngwal anà làkoo bye anà ngye. Yà abwɛy" ] »

content: « Undiir awun, bɛ làsàdwääl baar bumwɛy nkul a ibii aba, Taaràbɛ awà u du asàladwääl nkul abɛ sye.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa bɛ làdwääl anki baar bumwɛy nkul a ibii, Taaràbɛ sye usàladwääl anki nkul a ibii abɛ. »
Ukin isaa

« Mpal làkin bɛ isaa, twon lan'kal ngyɛb ngyɛb asànaa bàfàkyer baar a mpem yweel: ba bàfàsɔɔm ntabwey aba ntɔn baar bamɛn naa ba ban'kin isaa. Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa naa ba bàkyàwal bweel aba itaan.
Wɛɛ akà ngye, mpal akin ngye, sir may a usɔŋ kun'tswe angye, ywɛy ntabwey angye
ntɔn baar bàkɔɔn ayöb naa ngye an'kin udyà, wɛɛ Taaràŋà mpɛl awà u nku. Waa Taaràŋà awà afàyöb ndaa afàkyer ngye u nku, usafuur ya. »
In'naaŋ a du
« Twon lan'köŋà in'naaŋ abɛ u mɛɛn pà, ikal a in'swab anà an'tär myàfàdwa mya myanswà, ikal bàfàbilà mbüüb ntɔn muyib.
Wɛɛ akà bɛ, làköŋà in'naaŋ u du, ntɔn kwo itàkal nsɛɛl itàkal in'swab myàfàkwo anki mutay mya, ikal mpa bàfàbilà mbüüb anà mpa bàfàyib ba.
Ntɔn ikal awà un'naaŋ angye, mpem angye sye isàkal kwo. »
Pɛɛlà a ndür
« Dii là mwinà a ndür: isàkal naa dii angye là ubwaŋ, ndür angye yanswà isàkal aŋàpɛɛlà.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa dii angye lye anà ukyal, ndür angye yanswà isàkal uboo a mpib. Abun, isàkal naa pɛɛlà alà uboo a ngye là mpib, ya yà mpib a nkye ifà! »
Nzam lɛɛ ngim

« Mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki musyääl amfum abɔ̈ɔ̈l: taaŋ lumwɛy nde asàyiiŋ umwɛy anà asàkwen wumwɛy, taaŋ lumwɛy nde asàkàbääb a umwɛy anà asàbɛy wumwɛy. Bɛ, bɛ làkwe anki musyääl Nzam anà ngim taaŋ nsil la. »
Nkyän
« Undiir awun waa mɛ alakyään naa twon lan'man mpay ntɔn udii ndür abɛ, itàkal naa bɛ ya làsàbwää aben. Nkye mɔ̈ɔ̈ kà kan'söön isaa anki anà ndür kà yan'söön ipfɛy anki u ndöŋ?
Làler nɛn a du: ya ifàkɔn anki, ifàbwo anki anà ifàsà anki isaa uboo a ikɔr. Wɛɛ Taaràbɛ awà u du afàkyer adii! Nkye bɛ kà lan'söön ya anki u ndöŋ?
Nà uboo a bɛ kan'kwo mukwɛy ilä udu a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ntɔn nkyän ufàsà nde? »
« Waa ntɔn nkye làfàsà bɛ nkyän ntɔn ipfɛy? Làler iful a nsye ifàyɛl bya: bya ifàsal anki, bya ipfɛy byàfàtsum anki.
Wɛɛ mɛ alàkyään naa itàkal Salɔmun unsà làkoo ande lanswà, nde kàsàbwaar anki asànaa bya.
Isàkal naa Nzam afàbwää abà iteerà a ywaŋ akye anà möö ŋàbawà anà bàyàtɔɔm u mbaa nkàswo, nkye nde usàkyer anki yàŋàsöön akà bɛ, bɛ aŋàlàkwikilà ikikye?
Twon lan'sà nkyän anà mutɛn naa: "Ininà bi iyàdyà? ininà bi iyànwà? ininà bi iyàbwaar?"
Indiir abi byanswà baar mpa abà Ayudà bàfàleŋ bya taaŋ lanswà. Wɛɛ Taaràbɛ awà u du akyàyöb naa bɛ làbye anà ngyal a bya.
Wɛɛ akà bɛ, bɛ tàlaleŋà imwol anà balàbal a Nzam, waa nde usàlakwɛy indiir abi byanswà.
Undiir awun, twon lan'sà nkyän ntɔn nkàswo, ntɔn nkàswo akyer asàlɔ̈ɔ̈n nde ŋakwo. Ilä a ilä kye anà ndaa a kya. »
